slides.title: Impersonal passive
slides.subtitle: It is said that… / He is believed to…
goals: Use **It is said / believed / thought that…**

slides.title: Two structures

head: Structure
Example
rows: **It is believed that** the pyramid is 2,000 years old.
The pyramid **is believed to be** 2,000 years old.
He **is thought to have left** the country.

slides.tip: Common verbs: *say, believe, think, know, report, expect, consider*.

items.t: People say that he is a genius. → He is said ___ be a genius.
People think the thief escaped. → The thief is thought to ___ escaped.
They expect prices to rise. → It is ___ that prices will rise.
